description: LaunchTrace Score configuration. The score is an internal opportunity / early-stage signal from 0-100. It is NOT a probability that the company will buy from a subscriber.

confidence_requirements.note: A record cannot be presented as HIGH without a company match we are reasonably confident in. Without it the score is capped.
confidence_requirements.web_evidence_note: The HIGH band means 'we checked and this brand still looks early'. That check needs web evidence. Until SEARCH_PROVIDER and SEARCH_API_KEY are set, records are capped at the top of the MEDIUM band rather than presented as verified strong signals.

calibration_note: Weights are set so that a record with every positive indicator firing lands at 100, a strong record with verified web evidence lands in the mid-80s, and a record scored without web evidence tops out in the 70s. That is deliberate: without a search provider connected we cannot tell an early-stage brand from an established one, so such records are reported as MEDIUM rather than presented to a customer as a strong launch signal.

evidence_groups._note: Indicators grouped by the enrichment stage that produces them. When a stage did not run, its weight is redistributed across the indicators we could actually evaluate, so a record is not punished for research we chose not to buy. The band cap still communicates the thinner evidence.
